title: Korean, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's Suggested Academic Plan and Program Requirements tabs (bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2022-2023/undergraduate/colleges/liberal-arts/korean-ba/), fetched and cross-checked against the page's own raw HTML rather than trusting WebFetch's summary alone (per the known archive-page confabulation risk) -- the printed semester subtotals (16+16+16+16+16+16+14.5+13.5) sum to the page's own stated 'Total Credits 124', confirming the extraction. This is the pre-2025 Korean, B.A. curriculum, independently confirmed byte-identical in course sequence, credits, and pool composition through 2023-24 (KORBA-2023.json) and 2024-25 (KORBA-2024.json) -- see those files for their own separate fetch confirmations. Differs from the 2026 plan (KORBA-2026.json) in real, verified ways, not just relabeling: (1) no LA 83 (1.5cr Liberal-Arts first-year orientation course) in Semester 1 -- that requirement didn't exist yet on this archived page, so Semester 1 totals 16cr not 17.5cr; (2) no 'Second-Year Liberal Arts Seminar' in Semester 4, so it totals 16cr not 17.5cr; (3) the KOR 120/121 pool option is plain 'KOR 121' -- confirmed via the archived 2022-23 course-description page (bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2022-2023/university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/kor/), which titles it 'Korean Popular Culture' (3cr, no prereq); the 'N' Inter-Domain suffix and 'K-pop and Beyond' retitling ('KOR 121N') doesn't appear until the 2025-26 catalog (confirmed by diffing the archived course-description pages year over year -- see KORBA-2025.json). The resulting 124cr total matches the page's own stated total exactly (3cr less than 2026's 127cr, accounted for exactly by the LA 83 + Second-Year Liberal Arts Seminar 1.5cr+1.5cr additions in the newer plan). KOR 450 ('Korean Cultures in Global Contexts') was a real, currently-offered 3cr course in the 2022-23 catalog (confirmed via the same archived course-description page) -- unlike KORBA-2026.json, which correctly drops it because it was discontinued sometime before the 2026-27 catalog (confirmed absent from the live 2026-27 course-description page), this historical plan keeps the bulletin's real three-way 'KOR 450, 451, or 452' pool intact for Semester 6, since the course genuinely existed then. KOR 498 remains a variable 1-9cr Special Topics course in this catalog year too (confirmed via the same archived course-description page) -- excluded from the Semester 7 'KOR 422, 423, 424, 425, or 498' pool for the same reason KORBA-2026.json excludes it (not reliably 3cr), leaving the four confirmed-3cr options. 'Korea related courses from KOR and Beyond Coursework' (2 occurrences) remains a generic slot, same convention as 2026, since it's not an enumerated list on this archived page either. Reuses the same 42-course kor_catalog.json (all KOR courses are prereq-free); a plan-item code not present in that shared catalog (e.g. this file's 'KOR 121' vs. the catalog's 'KOR 121N') is treated by planner_engine.py as unconstrained (no prereqs), matching the course's real prereq-free status, so this is not a scheduling risk.
